doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: The garter snake in the banjo player's pocket
summary: To get even with the banjo player Big Boy, he hid a garter snake in his pocket during Doc's African leopard-skin tale, ruining the act.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: About Doc? Do you remember that one?

Oh, yeah, well, this happened, uh, in, in, uh, Rain, Louisiana. They had a, they show named Big, a banjo player. And he's one of these practice, uh, dear So that went on for two or three weeks. In my mind, I said, I've got to do something to get even with this guy. See, can he take a joke? So we were going crawfishing in this little town. And we got a little garter snake, about a foot long. I dug and put this garter snake in a sack. I knew right then when I'd seen this garter snake exactly what I was going to do with it. So we used to wear these Candid Strike jackets like Nappy Lamar used to use on his show. And I put it in this. I took this little garter snake and took it out and put it in this guy's pocket.
